contentSections: A facade is one of the few things you buy that you cannot return. Once the panels are on the wall, the colour is the colour, the gloss is the gloss, and the joint lines are what they are.

That is why choosing from a PDF catalogue or a phone screen is risky. Metal changes with light, angle and distance. A champagne finish that looks soft in a render can look yellow in afternoon sun. A texture that looks bold in a photo can look flat from the road.

Metaland Gurugram exists to remove that guesswork. It is the flagship experience centre of Metaguise, where you can handle real cladding samples, compare finishes side by side and understand what you are buying before you sign anything.
This guide explains what Metaland is, what you can see there, how to prepare for a visit, and what to check when you hold a sample in your hand.

Why You Should See Facade Samples in Person
Facade decisions go wrong in predictable ways, and most of them are about things a screen cannot show.
Colour shifts with light. Metallic finishes contain reflective particles. They look different at sunrise, noon and evening, and different again under artificial light.
Texture needs a hand. Whether a fluted profile feels sharp or soft, whether a 3D module has real depth or just looks deep in a render, you only learn by touching and tilting it.
Weight and thickness are invisible online. A lightweight panel and a rigid one look identical in a photo. They behave very differently in wind and during installation.
Edges and joints tell the truth. The way a panel is folded, cut and finished at its edge says a lot about the maker.
Scale changes everything. A 30 cm sample cannot show a 30 metre wall, but standing next to a larger mock-up helps you imagine it.
What You Can See at Metaland
Metaland is built as a working showroom for architects and clients rather than a retail store. The focus is on letting you compare.
Live Cladding Samples
You can examine real panels instead of thumbnails. Look at flat systems such as MetaCassette, vertical profiles such as MetaFlute, and modular systems such as MetaCoin.
Finish Samples

Finish is where many facades succeed or fail. Metaland lets you see the same shade in different coating systems, and compare gloss levels, metallic effect and surface feel. Read more about how we think about coatings on our MetaSurface page.
Parametric Panels

Parametric facades are the hardest to judge from drawings because every panel can be slightly different. Seeing a physical parametric panel helps you understand depth, variation and how light moves across it. If you are curious about the approach, explore our parametric facade solutions.
Metaguise Team Support

Samples alone do not answer project questions. Having someone from the team beside you means you can ask about cost, lead time, fixing methods and suitability for your climate, then see the answer on a real panel.
Who Should Visit a Facade Experience Centre?

Homeowners planning an elevation. If you are building or renovating a bungalow, villa or builder floor, seeing real finishes saves you from regretting a colour choice. Our guide to facade and elevation design in Delhi NCR is a good primer before your visit.

Developers and builders. Compare systems across budget levels and understand lead times before committing a tower.
Retail and commercial owners. If your frontage is your brand, check how finishes behave under shop lighting and street light.
Contractors and consultants. Confirm tolerances, fixing and detailing questions with the people who fabricate the panels.
How to Prepare for Your Visit to Metaland
A little preparation makes the visit far more useful. Bring or have ready:

• Photos of the building or site, from the road and from close up
  • Plans and elevations, even if rough
  • Approximate area of facade to be covered
  • Orientation of the main facade (north, south, east or west)
  • Your city and local climate conditions, such as coastal, dusty or very hot
  • A budget range, even a wide one
  • Two or three reference images of facades you like
If you cannot bring drawings, even phone photos help. The team can suggest realistic options from them.
8 Things to Check When You Hold a Cladding Sample
Whether you are at Metaland or anywhere else, use this checklist. It works on any sample from any facade company.
1. Look at it in daylight. Carry the sample outside if possible. Showroom lighting flatters.
2. Tilt it. Rotate it to see how colour and gloss shift with angle. Metallic finishes can change dramatically.
3. Run a finger along the edge. Edges should feel clean and finished, with no burrs or rough cuts.
4. Check the back. The reverse side shows how well the panel is made and whether it is coated or left raw.
5. Feel the weight. Ask the thickness and material grade. A panel that feels thin may flex under wind.
6. Ask how joints are handled. The gap between panels, the fixing method and the drainage detail decide how the facade looks in five years.

7. Ask for the coating warranty in writing. Metaguise coatings carry warranties in the range of 15 to 30 years depending on the finish. Whatever you are quoted, get the terms, the scope and the exclusions on paper.
8. Ask what happens at scale. A sample is perfect. Ask how colour consistency is maintained across thousands of panels.
Questions to Ask Any Facade Company Before You Shortlist
Metaland is useful because it makes these questions concrete, but you should ask them everywhere.

• Do you design, fabricate and install, or do you outsource?
  • Can I see completed projects in my city?
  • Can you produce a full scale mock-up for approval?
  • What is the lead time from approval to delivery?
  • Who is responsible if something fails after installation?
Our guide to how to choose a facade company for a home or office goes deeper on what a good answer sounds like.
A Simple Plan for Your First Hour at Metaland
A showroom visit can feel overwhelming if you walk in without a plan. Here is an order that works for most people.
Start with your own wall. Show the team your photos and drawings first. Samples mean far more when they are connected to a real building.

Narrow by system, not by colour. Decide whether you want flat, fluted, modular or parametric before you pick shades. Colour is easy to change later. System choice drives cost, lead time and structure.
Then compare finishes on your shortlist. Place two or three finishes next to each other and move them in the light. Photograph them, but trust your eyes more than your camera.
Finish with budget and timeline. Ask for a realistic range and a schedule. If the numbers do not fit, ask what could change, such as panel size, finish or the area covered.
Common Mistakes Visitors Make at a Facade Showroom
Choosing colour under showroom lights only. Always take a sample outside before final approval.
Falling for the most dramatic sample. The boldest panel in the room is rarely the right choice for a quiet residential street. Match the sample to the building and the neighbourhood.
Forgetting the sub-frame. The panel is only half the system. Ask what sits behind it and how it is fixed.
Not asking for the next step in writing. After the visit, request a short summary of what was discussed, including finishes, quantities and costs, so you can compare it with other quotes.

Metaguise is a facade company headquartered in Gurugram and founded in 2019. We design, engineer and install metal facades, parametric and kinetic cladding and building elevations across India. What Happens After You Visit Metaland?
Most visitors leave with one of three outcomes.
Clarity on a shortlist. You narrow ten options to two or three, with reasons.
A project brief. You walk away with a clearer idea of scope, budget and timeline to share with your architect.
A concept to develop. For bespoke projects, the team takes your references and drawings and works up an initial design direction.
Nobody should feel pressured at a showroom. Take the samples seriously, take your time, and compare. A facade you are happy with after ten years begins with an unhurried decision.
Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Metaland by Metaguise located?
Metaland is at Basement F17/4, DLF Phase 1, Sector 42, Gurugram, Haryana. It is the flagship experience centre of Metaguise, a Gurugram based facade company.

It is wise to call ahead on +91 98116 04449 or write to contactus@metaguise.com so the team can prepare relevant samples and make sure the right person is available for you.

Yes. Metaguise also runs an experience centre in Kolkata, so clients in eastern India can view samples and finishes in person without travelling to Gurugram.

Can I bring my architect or contractor?
Yes, and we encourage it. Having your architect, designer or contractor present helps align the design, fixing method and budget in a single conversation.

Is Metaland only for large commercial projects?
No. Homeowners, retailers and developers all visit. Whether you are planning a single accent wall or an entire tower, the samples help you decide with confidence.
